nodes.text: Let $E\subseteq (0,1)$ be a meaurable subset with Lebesgue measure $\lambda(E)$. Is it true that, for almost all $\alpha$,\[\lim_{n\to \infty}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{1\leq k\leq n}1_{\{k\alpha \}\in E}=\lambda(E)\]for all $E$?

#994 : [Er64b] analysis | discrepancy A conjecture of Khintchine [Kh23] . In fact this is false, and was disproved by Marstrand [Ma70] .
